rules: No silo may import another silo's inventory, customer state, copy, pricing, assets or identity data.
The DreamLedger front door must remain category-neutral and must not hard-code silo-specific branding.
Silo-specific pages and products must identify their own silo explicitly.
Cross-silo bundles are forbidden unless explicitly promoted as a new approved product in a dedicated neutral offer.
No crypto investment promise, personalized financial advice or financial performance claim may be published by the crypto silo.
MTG terminology and inventory remain confined to the MTG silo.
